title: Tiny, cute cherries
svg:

  <!-- tiny sparkle -->
  <path d='M74 30 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6 Z' fill='#fff4a8'/>
